lock. 0.2.0 - Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)

1. Java 21.
2. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ for 1.21.11 (https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/). Fabric API is NOT required.
3. Put lock-0.2.0.jar in your mods folder and launch the Fabric profile.
4. Right Shift opens the menu. Config: ~/.lock/config.json

lock-loader.jar is the standalone loading window (java -jar lock-loader.jar); it is visual only for now.
